files.description: Bike-share trips, 1 September to 1 November 2025 (1500 rows): trip_id (whole number), rider_id (refers to riders.csv), start_station and end_station (refer to station_code in stations.csv), started_at (timestamp written as YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM), duration_min (whole minutes; about 3% empty), distance_km (two decimals), fare (two decimals; about 3% empty), payment (card, app or cash; capital letters and spaces are inconsistent), rating (1-5 stars, whole number; about 19% empty).

task_text: In trips.csv, write each trip's duration_min as text in hours and minutes of the form H:MM (75 becomes 1:15, 9 becomes 0:09), leaving it empty where duration_min is empty. `result` should be a Series of these texts indexed by trip_id, in file order.
intended_computation: Read trips.csv; write duration_min as text H:MM (hours, colon, two-digit minutes; 75 -> 1:15, 9 -> 0:09), missing where duration_min is empty; a Series indexed by trip_id in file order.

acceptable_variants.notes: trip_id index may be text; the Series name is free
